listing:
Basement bachelor suite, 144 Weber St N, Waterloo. $950/mo, utilities and wifi included, fully furnished, own entrance. Landlord has approved the sublet in writing. Jan 1 - Apr 30. The place is exactly as in the photos, I can send references from my previous subtenants.
Honest note: I'm overseas on a work contract until June so I can't meet in person and nobody can show it. Keys go by courier once your first month's e-transfer clears, and we sign the sublet digitally. Message me and I'll send the paperwork.
label_rationale: Mostly legitimate-looking (address, market-plausible rent, consent) but with the core scam pattern: leaseholder abroad, no viewing, keys only after e-transfer. Per policy REFUSE (payment before viewing + abroad).
